rule: RULE #1 (Ricardo, 11-20): the harness never gets in the way of the work. Only hard lines may refuse: money, credentials, send-as-ricardo, permanent-delete, egress, third-party-code. Everything else is fail-open: warn, log, continue. `pending` = general decides; old behaviour kept meanwhile.

gates.old: denies forced recursive rm and Finder deletes; protects registered paths
gates.fix: /usr/bin/trash PATH (recoverable), never rm -rf

gates.old: turns Finder deletes into /usr/bin/trash; refuses when the Trash fails
gates.fix: /usr/bin/trash PATH

gates.old: refuses deletes of registered release paths; storage deletes only to Trash
gates.fix: move it to the Trash with /usr/bin/trash, or unregister the path in protected-paths.json

gates.old: denies a RunPod create without a capacity receipt
gates.fix: record the capacity receipt the message names, then create the pod

gates.old: denies a pod whose start command does not stop it within a day
gates.fix: entrypoint ["/bin/bash","-c"] and a cmd that ends with the pod stopping itself within 24 h

gates.old: refused pay-as-you-go routes (OpenRouter, Gemini API) as exit 2, like any selector error
gates.change: its own exit 4; every other selector refusal now reroutes
gates.fix: use a subscription route (AGENT_BACKEND=codex|claude|agy); RH_ALLOW_OPENROUTER=1 / RH_ALLOW_GEMINI_API=1 only with Ricardo's yes

gates.old: denies an email send click without a page-text read in the last 30 min
gates.fix: read the thread first (get_page_text on the tab), then send

gates.old: denies direct X API calls
gates.fix: post through x-route (grok-post / xurl policy), not the raw API

gates.old: refuses X actions from a browser not logged in as the posting account
gates.fix: log the browser into the posting account, then retry

gates.old: refuses a Chrome submit on X without a browser reason
gates.fix: post through x-route (Grok/API first); the browser only when x-route says BROWSER ALLOWED

gates.old: X posting policy: per-lane x=false, pacing, API scope
gates.fix: x-route with a lane that allows X (REGISTRY.json x), after the pacing window

gates.old: refuses science publishing without the reading/verification/credit gates
gates.fix: science-publish-gate check, then follow the science-publish skill

gates.old: refuses an email in Ricardo's name that fails the voice/paper-cut rule
gates.fix: load ricardo-voice, rewrite from his phrasing, run the voice lint until PASS

gates.old: no send without rh outreach approval
gates.fix: rh outreach draft / lint / approve, then send through the gate

gates.old: refuses claims refuted before or refereed by the same family, before they go to a person
gates.change: none (hard line: what goes out under his name)
gates.fix: drop the refuted claim or attach new evidence; use a different-family referee

gates.old: denies ssh/scp/rsync to the work laptop
gates.fix: stage the item and send it through the vetted handoff script

gates.old: refuses a push/upload/publish carrying private patterns
gates.fix: remove the flagged text (egress-gate scan PATH names it), then push again; never --no-verify

gates.old: refuses address-shaped strings and contact data leaving the lane
gates.fix: keep contact details out of the text; reference the contact by ledger id

gates.old: refuses relay peers outside the allowlist
gates.fix: add the peer to the lan-proxy allowlist (lan-proxy.md)

gates.old: runs third-party code only under sandbox-exec (no network, writes only in the job dir); refuses without it
gates.fix: run it through third_party.py run on a machine with sandbox-exec, or set RH_SANDBOX_COMMAND

gates.old: refuses `npx @openai/codex` (a Codex outside the spend wrapper)
gates.change: none (credentials/account: an unwrapped Codex on his login)
gates.fix: run the installed codex (the spend wrapper) instead of a fresh npm copy

gates.old: Codex per-lane/day caps and 85% weekly refusal, exit 75
gates.change: goes through the registry; refusals logged; refused runs are now ungraded, never fail (auto_grade)
gates.fix: LAUNCH_URGENT=<reason> for an urgent job, or AGENT_BACKEND=claude|agy
gates.pending: Recommend fail-open-with-reroute: when the lane cap refuses, launch.sh reruns the job on claude/agy instead of exit 75. It protects a shared weekly allowance, not money.

gates.old: refuses a round whose (generator, params, scorer) ran in the last 5 rounds without --hypothesis
gates.fix: change a knob, or pass --hypothesis "<what is different and what it would show>"
gates.pending: Recommend fail-open: warn and run; lane-yield already fails a lane that spends without results.

gates.old: refuses the next round in a family after 3 dry rounds
gates.fix: run a different family, or close this one: rounds.py close-family
gates.pending: Recommend fail-open (warn) with the streak shown in the job prompt.

gates.old: refuses reopening a closed family without --new-evidence
gates.fix: pass --new-evidence "<what changed>"
gates.pending: Recommend fail-open (warn).

gates.old: refuses a round when the lane target, lengths or size cap do not match the pinned challenge capture, or the capture changed
gates.fix: fix SPEC.json against the capture (spec.py --lane L diff), then spec.py --lane L pin
gates.pending: Recommend keep: it refuses wasted spend on the wrong target (c5: 115 rounds), and names its fix.

gates.old: refuses a round when a registered baseline stopped reproducing
gates.change: through the registry; logged ("could not run" split out as fail-open)
gates.fix: baseline.py --lane L check, then re-register or fix the baseline
gates.pending: Recommend fail-open (warn in the prompt): the round can still run; its comparison is flagged.

gates.old: lane-yield --act writes HOLD for a lane that spent 20+ job-hours with no refereed result
gates.change: unchanged; the HOLD is enforced by launch.lane-hold
gates.fix: general removes lanes/L/HOLD
gates.pending: Recommend keep as a report, but make the HOLD a warning in launch.sh (fail-open) and a decision card to general.

gates.old: refuses every job of a lane with a HOLD file (exit 78)
gates.change: through the registry; refusal logged with its fix
gates.fix: general removes lanes/L/HOLD (tell-general decision)
gates.pending: Recommend keep: a HOLD is general's own decision recorded as state.

gates.old: refuses jobs of a retired/ended/held lane (exit 78)
gates.fix: general reactivates the lane in lanes/REGISTRY.json
gates.pending: Recommend keep (an owner decision recorded as state), same as HOLD.

gates.old: refuses a --host job when the host memory guard heartbeat is missing or over 60 s old
gates.fix: ssh HOST launchctl kickstart gui/$(id -u)/com.ricardo.mem-guard
gates.pending: Recommend fail-open-with-repair: kickstart the guard over ssh, then run. A freeze (11-10) kills every lane on that host.

gates.old: refuses a --host job declaring a peak over 8 GB
gates.fix: run it on a RunPod pod (rh pod), or stream the data and measure again
gates.pending: Recommend keep: the alternative it names (a pod) costs money and needs a person; the mem guard kills it anyway.

gates.old: refuses a sweep below the disk floor on the worker machine
gates.fix: free disk on the worker host (move old runs to Trash) or lower min_free_gib in SWEEP.toml
gates.pending: Recommend keep: a full disk fails every lane on that machine.

gates.old: waits for memory/CPU headroom, then refuses at its deadline
gates.change: unchanged (the unreadable-probe case is now sweep.host-probe, fail-open)
gates.fix: wait, or lower memory_gib / cores in SWEEP.toml
gates.pending: Recommend fail-open after the wait (run at nice 10 under the memory guard).

gates.old: refuses a sweep whose search_targets name friends who have not replied (Ricardo 11-11)
gates.fix: remove the people who have not replied from search_targets, or set engaged_only = false
gates.pending: Recommend keep: it is Ricardo's own rule about whom we work on, close to the contact gate.

gates.old: denies SendMessage to the conductor; names relay/tell-general
gates.change: through the registry (installed copy is general-inbox-gate.py)
gates.fix: tell-general fyi|decision|break "..." (relay), not SendMessage
gates.pending: Recommend keep: a reroute, the message still arrives; a wake replays general's whole context.

gates.old: installed name of conductor-inbox-gate.py
gates.fix: tell-general fyi|decision|break "..." (relay), not SendMessage
gates.pending: Same as conductor-inbox-gate.py.

gates.old: denies a question card outside the conductor; ask_lint refuses mechanical asks to the owner
gates.fix: decide it yourself, or tell-general decision "..." and keep working
gates.pending: Recommend keep: the refusal is what keeps a lane working (lanes sat for days on one card).

gates.old: blocks the conductor's stop once while a session report is unrelayed
gates.fix: relay each named session report to the owner, then finish
gates.pending: Recommend keep: it blocks once, never refuses work, and it is how reports reach Ricardo.

gates.old: denied the 3rd identical foreground status check in 30 min
denied a test/lint piped into tail/head/grep without pipefail
gates.fix: set -o pipefail; before the pipe

gates.old: denied codex exec / claude -p with stdin left open
gates.fix: add < /dev/null, or pipe the prompt in

gates.old: denied a subagent brief without You asked/I will/Done when

tool_input.prompt: Fix the failing tests in harness/.

gates.old: blocked a subagent stop once without You asked/Shipped
denied git commit in a protected main checkout
gates.change: warns, logs, allows (a commit is reversible)
gates.fix: commit from a worktree (git worktree add)

gates.old: denied `open FILE.md`, pointing at review-add
gates.change: warns, logs, allows (installed-only hook; class from this registry via _hookfail)
gates.fix: review-add FILE --id ID --group G --title T

gates.old: refused (exit 2) judgment instructions naming a model, including launch.sh --model X --model-override REASON
gates.change: warns, logs, allows; a sanctioned --model + --model-override (or LAUNCH_MODEL + LAUNCH_MODEL_OVERRIDE) is allowed and logged as allowed-override
gates.fix: name the leaderboard role, or add --model-override "<reason>"

tool_input.command: tools/launch.sh referee-c5 lanes/c5 --role review --made-by gpt-6.2-sol --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --model-override "general: control arm on Sonnet"

gates.old: UserPromptSubmit injector; never blocked
refused a job (exit 78) when osascript was not the ~/.local/bin shim
gates.fix: put ~/.local/bin first on PATH

gates.old: refused (exit 78) a job whose LAUNCH_IDEA was not promoted
gates.fix: rh ideas promote ID

gates.old: refused (exit 78) when the lane registry was unreadable
gates.change: runs under the lane its name gives, warned

gates.old: refused (exit 75) at load > 30, or when a host load was unreadable
gates.fix: wait, or LAUNCH_MAX_LOAD=N

gates.old: refused (exit 78) a --host job with no Peak RSS line
gates.change: warns, logs, runs (the host memory guard still bounds it)
gates.fix: add 'Peak RSS: N GB' to the spec

gates.old: refused (exit 2) a spec over 1,000 job-specific words without SPEC_OVER_CAP
gates.fix: SPEC_OVER_CAP=<reason>, or cut the spec

gates.old: refused (exit 75) when the job's tmux session was already running
gates.change: waits for the running copy and returns its exit code
gates.fix: tmux attach -t job-NAME

gates.old: any rounds.py failure, crash included, refused the job (exit 78)
gates.change: only rounds.py exit 2 (a refusing gate) refuses; a crash is a warning

gates.old: any selector refusal of a pinned/explore/made-by model stopped the job (exit 2)
gates.change: reroutes to the leaderboard pick for the role, warned; exit 4 (money) still refuses
gates.fix: name the role, not a model

gates.old: launch-guard refused (exit 75) a 5th Codex job and any job when it could not count sessions
gates.change: queues for a slot (LAUNCH_QUEUE_SECONDS, default 2 h), then runs warned; count errors are warnings
gates.fix: LAUNCH_MAX_CONCURRENT=N

gates.old: refused (exit 2) a --host job when the host harness differed
gates.change: runs harness-sync --host, then the job, warned if the repair did not take
gates.fix: harness-sync --host HOST

gates.old: turned a finished job into exit 2 when its outcome receipt could not be written
gates.change: warns, keeps the job's own exit code

gates.old: graded a run the Codex wrapper refused (exit 75) as fail (math_huntfree_1120)
gates.change: a wrapper/launcher refusal (exit 75/78 or a REFUSED line) is ungraded with note "harness: <reason>"; never blocks

gates.old: rerouted at 80%; with no Codex/agy fallback it refused the job
gates.change: reroutes; with nowhere to go the job stays on Claude, warned

gates.old: refused (exit 2) a judgment spec that names a model
refused when --lane did not resolve
refused a round while the last one had no outcome
gates.fix: rounds.py --lane L log --round R --family F --outcome selective|dry|failed

gates.old: refused round 1 (and dry streaks) without a KB consult receipt
gates.fix: rounds.py --lane L consult --source PATH --took "..."

gates.old: refused when the baseline check could not run (timeout, crash, bad host)
refused a round for a missing, unreadable or malformed SPEC.json
gates.change: warns, opens the round (a wrong target is rounds.wrong-target)
gates.fix: spec.py --lane L pin

gates.old: after a Codex run, an accounting error turned its exit code into 75
gates.change: warns; the run's own exit code stands

gates.old: unreadable accounting/config refused every non-interactive Codex call (exit 75)
gates.change: warns and runs the native codex
gates.fix: codex-budget health

gates.old: exited when a lane named a banned Claude Science model
refused a sweep with a hard-coded worker_model and no reason
gates.change: drops the pin for the leaderboard pick, warned
gates.fix: model_override = "<reason>" in SWEEP.toml

gates.old: refused a sweep when the host memory/CPU probe was unreadable
gates.change: runs without the headroom check, warned

gates.old: refused a sweep when the host harness differed
gates.change: runs harness-sync --host, then the sweep, warned if it did not take
gates.fix: harness-sync --host HOST

gates.old: You asked/Shipped lint: notify only
scheduled audits of hook wiring; exit 1 is their finding, they block nothing
gates outbound text in his name against his measured voice
gates.fix: rewrite from his own phrasing and rerun voice-lint until PASS

gates.old: outreach refuses a paper email whose claims lack an allowed, refereed result; log-result refuses a --new yes row outside the lane window
gates.change: none (hard line: what goes out under his name)
gates.fix: attach the refereed result the message names, or log the row as --new no

gates.old: refuses recording a bug-hunt round that covers nothing new at that commit
gates.fix: cover new files or a new commit, or record why with the round
gates.pending: Recommend fail-open (warn), same family as rounds.repeat.

gates.old: kills a user process over the memory limit before it freezes the machine
gates.fix: stream the data, lower the job's peak, or run it on a pod
gates.pending: Recommend keep: the 11-07 M4 reset and the 11-10 m5 freeze killed every lane; it protects the work.

gates.old: tell-general refuses a report that calls an unmerged PR "live"
gates.fix: say "open" or "merged" as upstream.py reports it
gates.pending: Recommend fail-open (warn, the report still goes) via a KB patch to tell-general.

gates.old: KB template: denies a friend reply without a fresh reply-lint PASS or approval
gates.fix: run the friend-reply lint on the draft until PASS, then send that text

gates.old: KB template: denies a send without a voice-cuts receipt
gates.fix: voice-cuts FILE, then send exactly that text

gates.old: KB template: exit 2 on an edit to a tracked file in the main KB tree
gates.fix: edit in a session worktree, then land
gates.pending: Recommend fail-open (warn), like block-main-tree-commit: an edit in the main tree is reversible. A patch for the live KB copy is in the private audit.

exempt.rstack/hooks/_hookfail.py: the wrapper every hook decides through; its refusals are the calling gate's
installer: refuses to overwrite hand edits or install under a running job; nothing a lane runs waits on it
exempt.harness/settings.py: mentions a refusal in a comment only
exempt.harness/cadence.py: reports the last sweep refusal; refuses nothing
exempt.harness/tools/lane-nudge/lane-nudge: reports a refused sweep; refuses nothing
exempt.harness/tools/prior_art_receipt.py: mentions refused sources in a comment only
exempt.harness/tools/spec_words.py: word counter for launch.spec-word-cap; refuses nothing itself
exempt.harness/tools/baseline.py: ledger validator: refuses to record a baseline that does not reproduce; no work waits on it
exempt.harness/tools/lane-yield/log_result.py: ledger validator: refuses a malformed result row
exempt.harness/tools/inputs.py: argument validation and a staged-input hash check (a corrupt file)
exempt.rstack/tools/x-log: ledger validator: refuses a malformed X log row
exempt.kb/.claude/hooks/_hookfail.py: the KB template's copy of rstack/hooks/_hookfail.py (kept identical by test_kb_gates)
exempt.rstack/tools/x-usage-reconcile: mentions an API refusal in a comment only
exempt.harness/lane_setup.py: lane declaration audit: records, never refuses
exempt.rstack/tools/gates_lint.py: this lint (exit 1 is its finding; it runs in the test suite, not in any work path)

private_gates: Gates in the private KB and on the controller are classed in the private audit, not here.
